svg.title: SINGLE-AISLE TWIN ARCHETYPE — PLAN VIEW
svg.desc: Original orthographic plan view of a single-aisle twin-engine airliner archetype (single-aisle proportions), generated from parameters. Shaded ATA areas are indicative zones, not component locations. Not an OEM drawing; not engineering data.
